title: CROSS-CULTURAL VALUE ALIGNMENT FRAMEWORKS FOR RESPONSIBLE AI GOVERNANCE: EVIDENCE FROM CHINA-WEST COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS
benchmark_measurement: The paper cites prior work that used LLM Word Association Tests to measure 'pervasive stereotype biases' across models in the social category of religion. It also evaluates alignment with cultural values, noting that major LLMs exhibit values resembling those of Protestant European countries.
findings: The paper cites findings of pervasive stereotype biases related to religion in LLMs. Its own analysis reveals that major LLMs exhibit cultural values similar to those of English-speaking and Protestant European countries. It also acknowledges a limitation in its methodology, noting that the moral frameworks used are Western-centric and may underrepresent collectivist ethics like Confucianism.
references: EU Artificial Intelligence Act. The eu artificial intelligence act. European Union, 2024.
